Today, Apple's Instagram account posted a carousel featuring photos shot by photographers Jake Michaels and Jason Nocito, showcasing the camera of the all-new iPhone Duo. Here are the details.

Apple Shares Six 'Shot on iPhone Duo' Photos

For the past decade, Apple has showcased the camera capabilities of each new iPhone through its 'Shot on iPhone' campaign.

Ranging from everyday users to renowned photographers and filmmakers, Apple has used this campaign to promote new camera hardware, shooting modes, and other camera features exclusive to the iPhone.

This long-running campaign has also won multiple Cannes Lions, including two Grand Prix, and has been nominated twice for the Emmy Award for Outstanding Commercial.

Today, Apple posted a new carousel on Instagram showcasing the iPhone Duo 'with a versatile camera system packing tons of exciting new features'.

You can check out the six photos taken by photographers Jake Michaels and Jason Nocito below:

The iPhone Duo comes with a 48-megapixel rear camera, a 12-megapixel front camera, as well as a FaceTime camera built into the under-display, and will be available for pre-order starting Friday, October 16, with shipping and in-store availability beginning October 23.

Apple previously announced customers can get ready for iPhone Duo pre-orders starting October 12, and you can learn more about that here.

Are you planning to buy an iPhone Duo? Let us know in the comments.
